name: Kagi
tagline: Kagi is a paid, ad-free search engine that puts user experience above advertiser interests — results are never influenced by SEO manipulation or sponsored placement. Its AI features include Fast Answer (instant AI summaries at the top of results), Summarize (one-click summaries of any web page), and the Kagi Assistant, which combines search with GPT-4 and Claude for conversational research. Users who switch report significantly cleaner, more relevant results than Google, and the privacy-first business model has built a loyal subscriber base.
